headline: Generative AI Marketing Automations Notebooks
short_description: Explore innovative applications of generative AI in marketing, SEO, and public relations through a curated collection of automations and experiments. Ideal for marketers looking to enhance their strategies with AI-driven insights.
author: ktynski

sections.overview:
Marketing_Automations_Notebooks_With_GPT is a curated collection of 20+ Google Colab notebooks that automate discrete marketing, SEO, PR, and social media tasks using GPT-3, OpenAI Whisper, and multimodal AI models. The scripts handle keyword clustering for content gaps, long-form article generation with semantic SEO optimization, TikTok video analysis for viral factors, news monitoring and clustering, newsjacking ideation, and on-page link optimization. Built by Kristin Tynski, these automation tools help marketers identify content opportunities, generate optimized content, monitor brand presence, and streamline social media strategy without manual analysis.
Automate the generation of engaging content for marketing campaigns.
Enhance SEO strategies by identifying content gaps and optimizing keyword usage.
Create personalized outreach templates for PR campaigns using AI-generated insights.
Run A/B tests on marketing messages to determine the most effective strategies.
sections.usage:
